subject: english
question:
Identify the most appropriate meaning of the given idiom.

Bread and butter
solution:
The correct answer is **Option 2)**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The idiom **"bread and butter"** refers to one's primary source of income or means of livelihood. (रोज़ी रोटी)

 
 
• **Example:** Teaching is her **bread and butter**; it’s how she supports her family.
 
 
 
• **Means of livelihood** refers to the work or activity that provides the main income to sustain one's life. (जीविका का साधन)
 
 
• **Example:** Farming is the main **means of livelihood** for many people in rural areas.
 
 

Therefore, the correct meaning of the given idiom is '**Means of livelihood**.'

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

Here are the other options explained along with their Hindi meanings and example sentences:

 
• **Comfortable living** (आरामदायक जीवन): A lifestyle that is free of financial stress and allows for luxury and comfort.

 
 
• **Example:** After years of hard work, they finally achieved a **comfortable **living.
 
 
 
• **The breakfast** (नाश्ता): The first meal of the day.
 
 
• **Example:** They always have a hearty** breakfast **to start their day.
 
 
 
• **Money making** (पैसे कमाना): The act of earning money, often implying a focus on profit.
 
 
• **Example:** His new business venture is primarily focused on** money making.**
 
 

56:Tcc8,

The correct answer is **Option 1)**
